name: American Horror Story
description: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: A therapist and his family move across the country to escape their troubled past but quickly discover that their new home comes with its own horrific baggage.

videos.title: Home Invasion
videos.overview: Vivien and Violet get themselves caught in a dangerous situation. Meanwhile, Ben goes back to Boston to fix a mistake that he made.

videos.title: Murder House
videos.overview: Vivien learns the horrific truth about the house's first residents and Ben's visitor causes him to further unravel about what really happened in the haunted house. Constance and Moira have their history revealed.

videos.title: Halloween (1)
videos.overview: The line between the living and the dead blurs on Halloween. Two of the house's previous residents give the Harmons decorating advice.

videos.title: Halloween (2)
videos.overview: Tate comes face to face with his past, and Ben and Vivien are haunted by a new houseguest before Halloween night comes to an end.

videos.title: Piggy, Piggy
videos.overview: Constance enlists Violet's assistance with Tate. Ben helps a new patient confront his fears.

videos.title: Open House
videos.overview: Moira persuades a buyer to make an offer while Constance and Larry work against her efforts.

videos.title: Rubber Man
videos.overview: The man in the rubber suit is revealed.

videos.title: Spooky Little Girl
videos.overview: One of history's most famous murder victims pays the house a visit. Constance discovers more of Tate's bad behavior.

videos.title: Smoldering Children
videos.overview: Violet learns about the rules of the house. The truth about Larry's condition is explained. Constance is interrogated by the police.

videos.title: Birth
videos.overview: Vivien gives birth. Tate and Violet attempt to rid the house of some of its ghosts for good.

videos.title: Afterbirth
videos.overview: In the aftermath of family tragedy, Ben tries to take his child out of the Murder House. Meanwhile, Violet and Vivien accustom themselves to their new living arrangements, Constance raises Tate's child as her own and a new family buys the house.

videos.title: Welcome to Briarcliff
videos.overview: Terrifying evils blur the boundaries between reality and insanity at the Briarcliff Manor.

videos.title: Tricks and Treats
videos.overview: An exorcist is called to Briarcliff to help save a troubled farm boy; Sister Jude's darkest secret is revealed.

videos.title: Nor'easter
videos.overview: A violent storm allows a group of patients to plan a daring escape; Sister Jude is haunted by her past.

videos.title: I Am Anne Frank (1)
videos.overview: A new patient exposes Arden's past; Kit learns why Grace was admitted to Briarcliff.

videos.title: I Am Anne Frank (2)
videos.overview: Sister Jude employs a renowned Nazi hunter to gather evidence against Arden; Kit makes a surprising confession; Bloody Face is unmasked.

videos.title: The Origins of Monstrosity

videos.title: Dark Cousin

videos.title: Unholy Night

videos.title: The Coat Hanger

videos.title: The Name Game

videos.title: Continuum
videos.overview: A deadly new inmate threatens Sister Jude's chance of release; Grace's obsession with the aliens turns violent.

videos.title: Madness Ends
videos.overview: Johnny sets out to complete his father's work; Lana leads the charge to finally shut down Briarcliff.

videos.title: Fearful Pranks Ensue

videos.title: Burn, Witch. Burn!
videos.overview: Besieged by Marie Laveau's army, Zoe unleashes a new power; Fiona and Myrtle clash over control of the coven; Madame LaLaurie is confronted by old ghosts.

videos.title: The Axeman Cometh
videos.overview: Zoe, Queenie and Nan make contact with a dark spirit trapped in the academy; Cordelia's new power brings on a heartbreaking revelation.

videos.title: The Dead
videos.overview: Fiona finds purpose in a dangerous love affair; Queenie questions her place in the Coven; Cordelia makes a decision about her mother.

videos.title: The Sacred Taking
videos.overview: Cordelia rallies the girls in the fight to stop Fiona; a dangerous new enemy puts Misty in the cross hairs; the rivalry between Marie Laveau and Delphine comes to a head.

videos.title: Head
videos.overview: Cordelia's attacker is revealed. Fiona looks to form an alliance with Marie Laveau. Nan learns a disturbing truth about Luke's past.

videos.title: The Magical Delights of Stevie Nicks
videos.overview: Fiona attempts to out the new supreme with a visit from Stevie Nicks; Cordelia learns the truth about Hank and the witch hunters; Madison tries to eliminate her competition for the supremacy.

videos.title: Protect the Coven
videos.overview: Fiona and Laveau have a deadly face off with The Corporation; Cordelia makes a desperate sacrifice.

videos.title: Go to Hell
videos.overview: Cordelia's latest vision puts the coven's future in question; the girls manifest powerful new gifts; Queenie's search for Marie Laveau leads her to hell and back.

videos.title: The Seven Wonders
videos.overview: A new Supreme rises.

videos.title: Monsters Among Us
videos.overview: One of the only surviving sideshows in the country struggles to stay in business during the dawning era of television; police make a terrifying discovery at a local farmhouse.

videos.title: Massacres and Matinees

videos.title: Edward Mordrake (2)
videos.overview: Edward Mordrake continues his search for a Freak to add to his ghostly coterie. Elsa tells the grisly story of her days in Germany. Jimmy and Maggie have a run-in with the Twisted Clown.

videos.title: Pink Cupcakes
videos.overview: Stanley and Maggie hatch a plan to murder the Freaks. Gloria hides the evidence of Dandy's gruesome new hobby. A health scare reveals Desiree may not be the oddity she once thought.

videos.title: Bullseye
videos.overview: Elsa unveils a dangerous new act. Stanley puts pressure on Maggie to murder Jimmy. Paul indulges in a secret romance.

videos.title: Test of Strength
videos.overview: The women of the Freak Show rally against Dell after his latest act of violence. A strange encounter with Dandy raises Jimmy’s suspicion about the clown murders.

videos.title: Blood Bath
videos.overview: Recent disappearances around camp raise Ethel’s suspicion of Elsa. Gloria makes a last ditch effort to contain Dandy’s bloodlust.

videos.overview: In the wake of a tragic loss, Jimmy sinks into a drunken despair. A reading from Maggie spurs Dandy to action. Stanley and Elsa track down the Twins.

videos.title: Orphans
videos.overview: The death of a Freak sparks troubling behavior in Pepper. Elsa reveals the history of the Freak Show. Desiree grows suspicious of Maggie.

videos.overview: Elsa prepares for her move to Hollywood. The Twins grow enamored with a traveling salesman. Dell plots Jimmy’s escape from police custody.

videos.overview: Dandy gives the Twins troubling information about Chester. Maggie vows to prove her loyalty to Jimmy. The Freaks enforce their harsh code of justice.

videos.title: Checking In
videos.overview: Detective and family man John Lowe investigates a chain of gruesome murders in Los Angeles. A mysterious tip points him to the enigmatic Hotel Cortez.

videos.title: Mommy
videos.overview: Alex is pushed to her breaking point after Scarlett stirs up memories of Holden. Donovan is targeted by a dangerous rival of The Countess.

videos.title: Devil's Night
videos.overview: John receives an invitation to attend an exclusive Devil's Night Soiree. Alex tries to diagnose Holden's strange condition.

videos.title: Room Service
videos.overview: Alex uses an unconventional treatment to save a dying patient. A Halloween-hating couple tests Iris's limits.

videos.title: Room 33
videos.overview: Ramona and Donovan enact their plan for revenge. Liz Taylor finds true love. The resident of Room 33 is revealed.

videos.title: Flicker
videos.overview: Will Drake's renovations uncover one of the Hotel's greatest secrets. John undergoes psychiatric evaluation. The Countess learns the fate of her first love.

videos.title: The Ten Commandments Killer
videos.overview: John closes in on The Ten Commandments Killer. Sally's arrangement with March is revealed.

videos.title: She Wants Revenge
videos.overview: The Countess is reunited with her one true love. Donovan and Ramona take another stab at revenge. A careless decision lands Alex in hot water.

videos.title: She Gets Revenge
videos.overview: Alex enlists John's help to contain an outbreak. Donovan learns the Countess' true intentions. Liz and Iris plan to leave the hotel for good.

videos.title: Battle Royale
videos.overview: Ramona draws vitality from an unlikely source. Sally uses her past to negotiate her future. Scarlett learns the truth of her family's affliction.

videos.title: Be Our Guest
videos.overview: Iris and Liz oversee a new era at the Cortez. John and Alex struggle to adapt to life outside the hotel.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: A young interracial couple move into a farmhouse in North Carolina after purchasing it with their life savings. However, unearthly phenomena begin occurring and things are not what they seem.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: While the Millers discover some of their house's history, Lee falls into old habits and her daughter, Flora, makes a new friend.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Nightmares become an inescapable reality as unique stories of people's lives in America reveal the astonishing power of the supernatural.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: Scathach presents herself for the first time and reveals what she wants. However, Tomasyn and the ghost settlers have other plans.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: The mob comes for Shelby, Matt and Flora, but they get help from a new face to escape the Butcher's wrath.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: After the wrap of the show My Roanoke Nightmare, the producer creates a follow up show called Return to Roanoke, bringing the actors of the previous show and the real Shelby, Matt, and Lee, back to the house.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Audrey, Lee, and Monet find themselves in grave danger as they search for Rory; Agnes comes back for revenge; Matt and Shelby deal with the ramifications of their situation.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Audrey, Monet, and Lee remain hostages of the Polks, while Shelby and Dominic try to think of a way to escape the wrath of The Butcher back at the house.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: A new actor shows up to the house per Sidney's request; three young adults enter the woods to shoot footage of the blood moon and the history of the house for the web. Meanwhile Lee, Monet, and Audrey remain on the run.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Lee Harris, the lone survivor of Return to Roanoke: Three Days in Hell, agrees to an interview live on television, the Lana Winters Special.

videos.title: Election Night
videos.overview: After Trump is elected President, Ally Mayfair-Richards is beset by all of her old phobias... and they appear to be coming to life.

videos.title: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark
videos.overview: Ally, Ivy and Oz meet the new neighbors. Kai runs for city council. Detective Samuels investigates a murder. A blackout terrorizes Ally.

videos.title: Neighbors from Hell
videos.overview: The community turns on Ally after she shoots and kills a Hispanic man. At home tensions between Ally and Ivy grow worse, and Kai may be Ally's only hope.
Kai gathers familiar faces to join his cult as the events surrounding 11/8/17 are explored.

videos.title: Holes
videos.overview: Kai asks for the cult members to prove their loyalty against one of their own. Meanwhile, Ally meets with Rudy to tell him about her problems dealing with Ivy's departure.

videos.title: Mid-Western Assassin
videos.overview: Ally takes Meadow to Rudy in the hopes that she will confirm her story about the cult. However, Meadow has a change of heart. Meanwhile, an unexpected opponent runs against Kai in the city council election.

videos.title: Valerie Solanas Died for Your Sins: Scumbag
videos.overview: Kai begins to solidify his grasp on power after winning the election. A mysterious woman warns Beverly, Ivy and Winter that Kai will soon cast them aside.

videos.title: Winter of Our Discontent
videos.overview: Ally confronts Kai meanwhile Winter must choose between Kai and Beverly when he makes a questionable decision.

videos.title: Drink the Kool-Aid
videos.overview: Kai seeks to test the loyalty of his cult. Ally seeks revenge. Oz learns about his parentage.

videos.title: Charles (Manson) in Charge
videos.overview: Kai receives visits from Charles Manson as he begins to question everyone around him.

videos.title: Great Again
videos.overview: Kai sets his master plan into motion as Ally's true intentions are revealed.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: The end of the world happens when the bombs drop, and the survivors wonder if surviving is worth it after the Cooperative gives them shelter.

videos.title: The Morning After
videos.overview: A new occupant arrives at the Outpost with alarming news, causing a domino effect of lust, betrayal and self-destruction.

videos.title: Forbidden Fruit
videos.overview: As Ms. Mead grapples with her identity, Michael reveals more of his; Coco's ex rears his ugly head; Venable crafts a plan to give the residents of Outpost 3 one magical night.

videos.title: Could It Be... Satan?
videos.overview: Michael's history as a teenager, and how he came to find himself at the Hawthorne Boy's school, is revealed.

videos.title: Boy Wonder
videos.overview: After witnessing the Apocalypse, Coredelia must act quickly to stop Michael or face the end of days.

videos.title: Return to Murder House
videos.overview: Madison and Behold travel to the Murder House to uncover the origins of Michael Langdon.

videos.title: Traitor
videos.overview: Cordelia takes steps to punish the traitors among the coven and stop Michael from rising to power as the Antichrist.

videos.title: Sojourn
videos.overview: Michael questions his father's unholy plan for world annihilation, and is directed on the proper path to recover Miriam.

videos.title: Fire and Reign
videos.overview: Michael strikes at the school, but Cordelia, Myrtle, and Mallory escape him. Mutt and Jeff step in to guide Michael to his destiny, and recruit Wilhelmina to administer the Outposts.

videos.title: Apocalypse Then
videos.overview: The surviving witches travel to Outpost 3 to stand in final battle against the Antichrist.

videos.title: Camp Redwood
videos.overview: In the summer of 1984, five friends escape Los Angeles to work as counselors at Camp Redwood. As they adjust to their new jobs, they quickly learn that the only thing scarier than campfire tales is the past coming to haunt you.

videos.title: Mr. Jingles
videos.overview: Darkness descends upon the camp. Although it's lights out, evil has no curfew.

videos.title: Slashdance
videos.overview: Imitation is the best form of tragedy. Coming clean can be pretty messy.

videos.title: True Killers
videos.overview: Mr. Jingles closes in on the one who got away as the counselors rally to escape Camp Redwood.

videos.title: Red Dawn
videos.overview: As twilight broaches, the survivors brace for a final brawl.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: With the horrors of the night behind them the survivors deal with the fallout of their choices.

videos.title: The Lady in White
videos.overview: A hidden chapter of Camp Redwood is revealed. The survivors help a stranded hitchhiker.

videos.title: Rest in Pieces
videos.overview: A deadly trio emerges, hell-bent on unleashing a new era at Camp Redwood. Our former counselors desperately try to keep history from repeating itself.

videos.title: Final Girl
videos.overview: Camp Redwood draws in a lost soul looking for closure.

videos.title: Cape Fear
videos.overview: A struggling writer, his pregnant wife, and their daughter move to an isolated beach town for the winter. Once they're settled in, the town's true residents begin to make themselves known.

videos.title: Pale
videos.overview: A quick fix for Harry's writer's block has unexpected side effects. Two eccentric locals offer Harry a helping hand.

videos.title: Thirst
videos.overview: Harry's newfound talent brings an unexpected visitor to town. Alma decides to take matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Blood Buffet
videos.overview: The dark history of Provincetown and its residents are brought to light.

videos.title: Gaslight
videos.overview: Harry struggles to keep Alma under control. Doris is pushed past her limits.

videos.title: Winter Kills
videos.overview: Ursula devises a sinister plan. The Gardners write their final act.

videos.title: Take Me to Your Leader
videos.overview: A group of college students on a camping trip are swept up in a horrifying and deadly conspiracy decades in the making.

videos.title: Inside
videos.overview: The President struggles with the morality of a deal he must make.

videos.title: Blue Moon
videos.overview: An unexpected visitor arrives at the White House and reveals the details of a very horrific plan.

videos.title: The Future Perfect
videos.overview: Mamie takes matters into her own hands. The fate of the future is revealed.

videos.title: Something's Coming
videos.overview: Mysterious deaths and disappearances ramp up in the city. A doctor makes a frightening discovery, and a local reporter becomes tomorrow's headline.

videos.title: Thank You for Your Service
videos.overview: Gino grapples with his trauma. Patrick's search takes him to dark places. A stranger contacts Hannah with a grave warning.

videos.title: Smoke Signals
videos.overview: Without the NYPD's help, Gino is forced to get resourceful. A traumatizing event brings dangerous suspects closer than ever.

videos.title: Black Out
videos.overview: As darkness consumes the city, evil takes root in the unlikeliest of places...

videos.title: Bad Fortune
videos.overview: Hannah receives concerning news while Patrick suffers a loss; the city's most dangerous resident reveals his true motives.

videos.title: The Body
videos.overview: A chilling event from Patrick's past returns to haunt him. Gino and Henry are determined to uncover it at any cost.

videos.title: The Sentinel
videos.overview: Patrick's search reaches an epic conclusion; the group shifts its focus, but a different plan is in store for Hannah.

videos.title: Fire Island
videos.overview: Terrifying events at Fire Island rupture the group and force them to reconsider everything.

videos.title: Requiem 1981/1987 (1)
videos.overview: As vitality expires, two old friends are led through unique journeys of retrospection.

videos.title: Requiem 1981/1987 (2)
videos.overview: Grief and peril dominate Gino; the discovery of a tragedy becomes a revelation for Adam.

videos.title: Multiply Thy Pain
videos.overview: After multiple failed attempts of IVF, actress Anna Victoria Alcott wants nothing more than to start a family. As the buzz around her recent film grows, she fears that something may be targeting her - and her pursuit of motherhood.

videos.title: Rockabye
videos.overview: It’s awards season and Anna is primed to be a major player in contention. After a frightening encounter convinces her that she’s being followed, she begins to question who she can trust.

videos.title: When the Bough Breaks
videos.overview: As Anna and Dex settle into their Hamptons sanctuary, the comfort begins to fade. Her circle of trust is slowly shrinking, and doubt creeps into Anna’s head - could the evil be right under her nose?

videos.title: Vanishing Twin
videos.overview: With help from Siobhan, a major announcement helps restore Anna’s public image. Behind closed doors however, something powerful seems to be taking over.

videos.title: Preech
videos.overview: Anna senses the dark presence closing in on her, closer than ever. Ms. Preecher reveals pieces of her past and may know the truth about what's happening to Anna and Dex.

videos.title: Opening Night
videos.overview: A glimpse into Anna's past reveals why she craves motherhood, while Dex's troubling family life is dragged into the spotlight.

videos.title: Ave Hestia
videos.overview: Entrenched in her grapple for fame and motherhood, Anna may be involved in a cycle much bigger - and older - than she realizes.

videos.title: Little Gold Man
videos.overview: The world around Anna is starting to crescendo in every way: her career path continues to skyrocket, while her personal life is more stressful than ever - just in time for Hollywood's big night.

videos.title: The Auteur
videos.overview: Her choices have unknowingly led to deadly consequences, but Anna can still have it all - for a price.
